Self-Healing Knowledge BaseAI-Powered Enterprise Search & DiscoveryAI-Powered Authoring ToolsData Foundations
Bloomfire’s self-healing knowledge base uses AI to flag outdated or redundant content before it pollutes your search results. Authors are prompted to proactively update or archive; no manual audits required. This improves data quality without extra overhead and ensures your teams are always working with accurate, trusted information.
Identify stale or duplicate content before it spreads
Trigger review workflows to keep answers accurate
Maintain a single source of truth across departments
Reduce risk, clutter, and content decay over time
Bloomfire deep indexes all your content across formats and locations—so you can find exact answers fast, even inside slides, audio, or video. Stop wasting time searching and start surfacing what matters.
Index all your structured and unstructured content
Ask AI and get verified answers with clickable citations
Search inside video/audio clips and highlight key phrases
Get topic-based alerts and auto-populated feeds
Automatically tag, summarize, and categorize content when uploading. Bloomfire’s AI-powered authoring tools make sharing knowledge and finding natural search terms easy while new hires learn your company’s internal shorthand.
Generate summaries and titles from uploaded content
Auto-tag topics using natural language processing
Combine related knowledge into a shareable series
Govern visibility with role-based permissions
Before you can fully leverage AI, you need the right knowledge management software to organize and prepare your data. From cleanup to API connections, Bloomfire lays the groundwork for reliable, real-time knowledge delivery.
AI-Ready Data: Centralize and clean your knowledge to power accurate, trustworthy AI.
Integrations: Seamlessly connect with the tools your teams use daily.
Intelligence Layer: Unite knowledge across systems so teams and AI work smarter together.
API & Extensibility: Embed trusted insights directly into your everyday workflows.
The 2026 Guide to Enterprise Intelligence SystemsIn this second edition of the Guide, the scope is expanded to not only include knowledge management but also to look at enterprise search tools and business intelligence platforms to help buyers assess the full technology needed to achieve Enterprise Intelligence in their organization.
